transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We're here for the readiness review before we finalize the launch plan for the real-time collaboration service going to production Monday at 09:00 UTC. The draft plan has a 10% rollout, 10,000 concurrent connection cap, 5-second retry interval, primary region storage, and 90-day transcript retention. I'd like to go around the room for final sign-off from each area — backend engineering, reliability, privacy, and customer success. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something before we finalize. This afternoon, while investigating an unrelated mobile performance report, I confirmed that mobile clients resume from background in bursts and currently retry every 5 seconds, which can create a reconnect storm. The rollout policy should set the retry interval to exactly 30 seconds. I haven't filed the client-library ticket yet, but this is critical for launch.

transcript.text: I need to flag a capacity issue before we finalize. About 20 minutes ago, I completed a production-traffic replay and confirmed that the collaboration cluster's safe connection ceiling for Monday is exactly 6,000 concurrent connections — not the 10,000 in the draft plan. The autoscaling limit hasn't been updated yet because the replay results are still being attached to the capacity worksheet. We need to lower the concurrent connection cap to 6,000 before this plan is finalized.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag two privacy compliance issues before we finalize. I completed a privacy review this morning and confirmed that collaboration content for EU accounts must remain in the EU processing region — the draft plan's primary region storage would violate this. Additionally, session transcripts must be deleted after exactly 30 days, not the 90 days in the draft plan. I haven't opened the compliance ticket yet because legal was still reviewing the wording, but both of these must be corrected in the launch plan before we proceed.

I reconciled the customer-success rollout spreadsheet an hour ago and confirmed that six accounts — acct-204, acct-219, acct-233, acct-241, acct-278, and acct-301 — have administrator opt-out commitments until their enablement sessions are complete.
